$comment: Likud 2026 primary results (EventResults). No official vote-count/vote-order document has surfaced yet, so `raw` is omitted entirely — only `final`, the seated list, is populated. Source: the party's published final list at https://plikud.c14.co.il/ (scraped 2026-08-18, the day after the primary). Five reserved slots (seats 3, 9, 15, 26, 29) appear on that list as unnamed 'שריון' placeholders with no candidate assigned yet and are omitted here — seat numbers below have gaps where those sit. `reason` ids resolve to prose in this event's locale fragment (resultReason): chair (party leader, did not stand), reserved (an unelaborated reserved slot per the party list), women_representation_guarantee, new_woman_seat. Six seated names are not in candidates.json because they did not stand in the researched primary field (party leader, merger/reserved appointees, or a district winner outside our researched roster) — they carry display-only locale entries instead. Replace with `raw` once an official tally is published.
